__readme: This file drives the GUI of the Room Config Builder. Edit it and press
'Reload Schema' in App Config (or restart the app) - no rebuild needed.
Each entry under 'fields' is keyed by a config.json property name and supports:
label:       Field label shown in the editor (defaults to the raw key).
description: Text behind the (i) info button.
helperText:  Small grey hint line under the field.
type:        auto | text | int | double | bool | dropdown | combo | hidden.
'auto' (default) infers from the JSON value type.
options:     For dropdown/combo. Plain strings, or objects with value/label.
writes:      For combo only - the list of config keys the one dropdown writes.
Combo options use 'values' (one entry per key in 'writes').
Keys may contain '*' wildcards (e.g. 'power1_outlet_*') to cover a whole
family of properties. Exact keys always win over wildcard matches.
Keys starting with '__' are ignored (use them for comments).

btn_name.description: GUI object name for the connection status that has two states. Usually represented as a red dot when disconnected.

com_type.description: Type of connection as a string (Serial, SerialOverEthernet, Network).

host.description: The processor or spdevice in use for serial connections.

relay_host.description: The processor in use for the relay power control.

device_id.description: The ID to be sent to the device if it is required.

gve_id.description: String that identifies the device in GVE. Needs to be created when you add the room devices to GVE.

input.description: Input for the device. The subscribe status will change to this input. (Examples: HDBaseT, HDMI 1, Digital Link).

ip_address.description: IP address for the device as a string.

keep_alive_command.description: Command as a string to send to the device once connected. Chosen from the dictionary of commands in the module.

keep_alive_interval.description: Timing for sending the keep_alive_command as an integer.

keep_alive_qualifier.description: Only needed if the command requires a qualifier (Example checking an audio group such as '1' as the qualifier).

lbl_name.description: Name for the GUI object that will be written for connection status.

manual_disconnect.description: Flag to disconnect the item. Used if a projector or item is temporarily removed from a room.

model.description: Model of the device as a string.

keep_alive_trigger.description: Delay the keep_alive_command until the trigger is received such as the APC needing to complete the login before polling.

default_cc_aud_cam.description: Make the system show the audience camera as the capture source on startup.

gui_capture_source_available.description: Determine if the user can change the capture source on the touch panel.

ntp_secondary.description: Network Time Protocol (NTP) secondary server address in use for the processor.

pcmac.description: Future use for the mac address on the local PC.

gui_demo_mode.description: Operate the touch panel while not connecting to any device.

use_device_mute.description: Boolean for whether a mute command will also call to the device when video mute is pressed.

user.description: Username for the device when using a network connection.

password.description: Password in use while using a network connection that requires authentication.
